name: Insightful Terror [Psionic]
body:
Your insight into how fear affects creatures allows you to paralyze an enemy with fear, instead of merely shaking him.

Prerequisites: Fearsome insight class feature, Intimidate 9 ranks.

Benefit: As a standard action you can make an Intimidate check to demoralize a single foe (within 30 ft). If you succeed the target is paralyzed for one round. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

normal: A creature demoralized through Intimidate is shaken.
